title: Settings
subtitle: How your library works behind the scenes.
sections.dataModel.title: Data model
sections.dataModel.description: Custom fields and entity types for your library's records.
sections.import.title: Import & migrate
sections.import.description: Move your existing catalogue, members, and circulation into Libriant from a CSV, Excel, or MARC file.
sections.comingSoon.title: More coming soon
sections.comingSoon.description: Loan policies, notification templates, and per-tenant branding will live here.
sections.export.title: Export data
sections.export.description: Download your library's whole database as CSV, JSON, Excel, or a SQL dump.
export.title: Export data
export.subtitle: Download a full copy of your library's database.
export.hint: We build the file in the background — it'll appear below to download when it's ready.
export.started: Export started — it'll be ready shortly.
export.listHint: Files are kept for about a day. Auto-refreshes while building.
sections.delete.title: Delete this library
sections.delete.description: Close your library and permanently erase its data.
sections.delete.body: For your protection, libraries can only be deleted by the Libriant team. Send us a deletion request and we'll permanently remove your library and all of its data. This can't be undone.
sections.delete.emailBody: Please permanently delete our Libriant library (slug: {slug}) and all of its data. I understand this is irreversible.
staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: The people who can sign in to your library. Admins manage the library; librarians and volunteers do day-to-day work.
staff.createHint: We'll generate a username and a temporary 4-digit password. They set their own name + password on first sign-in.
staff.credsBody: Share these — the password won't be shown again. Username: {username} · Temporary password: {password}
staff.pendingSetup: Hasn't set up their account yet
staff.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They won't be able to sign in anymore.
dataModel.title: Data model
dataModel.subtitle: Add custom fields to the records your library keeps. Changes apply on the next form load — existing rows aren't touched.
dataModel.fieldsHint: Drag a field, or use the up/down arrows on its row, to reorder. Existing records keep their old values when you archive or restore a field.
dataModel.empty: No custom fields yet for this entity. Click "Add a field" to get started.
dataModel.previewHint: Live preview of the form your staff will fill in. Try typing — nothing is saved.
dataModel.form.fieldKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. We'll generate one from the label if you leave this blank.
dataModel.form.typeLocked: Type cannot change once a field exists — that's a safety rail against breaking existing records.
dataModel.form.requiredHint: When on, new records must provide a value. Existing records aren't affected.
dataModel.form.optionsHint: Each option needs an internal value (lowercase, no spaces) and at least one display label.
dataModel.form.optionsEmpty: At least one option is required for pick-one / pick-many fields.
dataModel.form.errors.labelRequired: The English or Greek label can't be blank.
dataModel.form.errors.fieldKeyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only. Start with a letter.
dataModel.toast.archived: Field archived. Existing values are kept; new records won't use it.
